Initial release of the Airbnb Listing Optimizer skill.

- Audits and optimizes short-term rental listings (Airbnb, VRBO, Booking.com) to improve search ranking, booking conversion, and review quality.
- Provides a 6-pillar listing audit with scores and prioritized fixes across title, photos, description, amenities, house rules, and response policy.
- Rewrites listing titles based on proven formulas for visibility and click-through.
- Advises on optimal photo ordering, lifestyle/feature balance, and hero shot techniques.
- Offers actionable guidance for dynamic pricing, Superhost metrics, and review management.
- Supports multi-platform syndication and short-term rental compliance.
